Import Texture2D PNG bytes through role-aware post-processing, return processed PNG hashes, save outputs, and read back texture metadata
Import a Texture2D, preview a batch rename without mutating the asset, apply the same rename, save, and verify old/new paths
Import a Texture2D from disk, prove no-overwrite conflict reporting on the same destination, then overwrite through the policy alias and inspect the saved asset
Import a disposable Texture2D, delete it through the editor namespace with an allowed-prefix guard, and verify the asset is gone without touching the rest of the benchmark root
Resolve the project engine, import an engine TTF as UFont/UFontFace assets, save them, and inspect both outputs
Create and save two Texture2D assets, inspect them as a batch, validate a dry-run delete, delete one asset, and verify the remaining/deleted rows
Import a Texture2D, edit an editor-visible texture setting, save it, then validate typed asset enrichment and the supported enricher registry
